title: Blog Example Layouts
intro: Fifteen editorial layouts for blogging and public writing — essay, photo essay, interview, diary, listicle, case study, tutorial, opinion, event recap, review, data story, announcement, profile, travelogue and digest.

add_paragraph.heading: How to use them
add_paragraph.text:
Every layout is one JSON file in `data/blog_examples/`. Copy the file, rename it, and edit the words; the layout is already designed. A page opens at `pages/page.html?folder=blog_examples&page=<file name>`, and elsewhere you link to it as `@blog_examples.<file name>`.

All of them are written with `add_content_to_page`, so repeated headings, lists and quotes stay in the order you write them.

add_table.heading: The fifteen layouts
content_of_rows_separated_by_comma: A slow argument with a lead image and pull quote

add_special_note.heading: One rule worth knowing
add_special_note.text: A JSON object holds each key **once**. For two headings or three lists, write them inside an `add_content_to_page` array — one element per entry. Repeating the same top-level key silently keeps only the last one.
